You can see a horribly beat-up airplane. It's dark and hard to make out, but it's been patched up all over, so...
[06]its owner clearly won't scrap it.
Oh! You're Susa, aren't you! Wanna go storm the "Demon Beast Swamp"?
[07]How do we get there, you ask? Isn't it obvious?! ▼ [07]In my airplane! She may not look like much, but she flies better than anything!
[07]Heh heh, and we've even got gasoline! Let's go!
Hey! The engine's acting up! We're gonna crash! Brace yourselves!
Phew! We made it! The "Demon Beast Swamp" is just to the east! ▼ [07]I'll fix the airplane! You guys go on to the swamp!
[07]So, I've got a favor to ask. Truth is, I'm out of gasoline and in a bind. ▼ [07]Could you buy some for me from the folks in "Gasoline Town"?
[07]They won't sell to me. Please! C'mon, c'mon!
That was a blast! Let's go again!
Hey, are you that Susa everybody's talking about?! Say! Once my plane's fixed, wanna go storm the "Demon Beast Swamp"?!
How about a "sightseeing flight"?!|
[07]All right! Let's go!

That's the Village of Hope.
That's the cult's temple over there.
This is where the cult's temple used to be.
This island's where I live.
These are the ruins of a town. Word is there's a huge labyrinth in there.
How about that! Fun, wasn't it? Come fly with me again.
[07]Not coming, huh... That's too bad.
Sorry, but I don't fly at night. Come back tomorrow.
[07]Hey! You don't have enough money. I can't take you up for that, no way.
Sightseeing flights are suspended. Anyone who wants to fly, come to the island.
Oil is floating on the water!
There's a pitch-black spring. It smells of petroleum.
All right! We're getting out of here! Climb aboard!
Hey! You're running away without what we came for?!
Heh heh! That was fun! See ya!
You felt power surging through your whole body!

Diving equipment. With this, it looks like you could dive even in deep water.
A transport plane sank down there! It's too deep to do anything without the proper gear!
No good! Halfway down you run out of breath. There's no way to reach the transport plane.
[06]To get it, you need something that lets you dive deeper... something like an "Oxygen Tank"!
A breathing tube. It lets you dive in shallow water.
S... Susa... just now... those guys... the Magatama... ▼ [07]They're... strong... We couldn't... do a thing...

Susa! I have no time to waste on you! Come forth, my servants!
You persistent pest!
We did it! The Magatama! ▼|Oh! Susa! In a hurry, were we? But you're one step too late. Farewell!
You can't go up there! We're charging the Magatama with energy.
[07]Curious about the Magatama?| »Of course I am.%| »I've already heard.%
[07]The Magatama is our civilization's ultimate defensive weapon. ▼ [07]It can block every kind of offensive ESP, so the enemy can use little more than Cure.
[07]They say that so-called strongest squad is after it too, but as long as we're guarding it, it's safe!
[07]It'll be ready soon, so please wait until then.
I am Magora, dispatched from the Rangoon. ▼ [07]I'll tell you where the Rangoon is, so listen carefully.
[07]Take the hovercraft west until you can no longer see the town. ▼ [07]Then head south. Go on for about a day and you'll reach the Rangoon.
[07]Everyone is waiting for you! Please hurry!
[07]Also, the Elder entrusted me with this. ▼ [07]It's the ultimate medicine. It fully restores your party's health.
[07]Think carefully about when to use it.
You've finally come! First, I shall give you what you need above all else: three suits of armor.
Now, it may take a little while, but listen to what I have to say.
[06]As you surely know, Susano Oh is the rage in your own heart, which appeared because you, "Shingo Susa," lost yourself in fury.
[06]Of the three parts Susano Oh split into, you have defeated two and made it here. ▼[06]And your journey is nearing its end.
[06]Now you must travel the world and make your final preparations. Here is the first of them.
[06]Your equipment for the final battle is still missing a piece. Find the "Kusanagi Sword"!
[06]One of the Twelve Heavenly Generals was bringing it to you, but it was stolen, and it seems to be hidden in a tower somewhere.
Don't you have the "Helm of Dreams"? Didn't you meet one of the Twelve Heavenly Generals in "Mountain Village"?
You don't have the "Silver Helm." It should be in the "Village of Hope"! It's kept there as the village's guardian!
[06]Bring back the energy capsule the Rangoon needs to fly. ▼[06]It's in the Demon Beast Swamp, east of what was the Beast Demon King's castle, surrounded by mountains!
[06]The Demon Beast Swamp is ringed by mountains, but there should be a man nearby with an airplane! Go and find him!
Elder! Our engine failed while we were transporting the Sword of Power, and we landed on the water. ▼ [07]We're on a river, with the "Mountain Castle" visible to the east.
[07]Requesting rescue! ▼|...What... who are those five? Whoa! We're under attack! Requesting immediate rescue...!
[07]Grandfather! We've lost contact! It seems they were attacked by that squad!
[06]So it seems! We must send help at once! Shingo Susa! Hurry and go to their rescue!
[06]It's somewhere on a river with the "Mountain Castle" in sight to the east! Hurry!
We've just received word that the Magatama is fully charged with energy. Go and get it.
[06]It's in a tower on an island east of South Port! Go!
What?! The Magatama was stolen?! Hmm... what's done is done. ▼[06]Until the Rangoon is ready, let me tell you a story.
[06]You must be wondering how I know so much. ▼[06]There is a reason.
[06]We of the Mitsurugi clan are charged with watching over you, the reincarnation of the hero Susanoo-no-Mikoto and of "Susano Oh."
[06]Since ancient times, whenever you unleashed your power as Susano Oh, we fought you...
[06]and when you were reborn as Susanoo-no-Mikoto, we helped you fight the demon beasts. ▼[06]It is a history that has continued ever since ancient Atlantis.
[06]And now, the Susano Oh of the Sky has revived the greatest demon beast in the universe, which had been sealed away: "Yamata-no-Orochi"...
[06]He means to turn this world once again into a world of evil, where only demon beasts live!
[06]Shingo Susa... no, hero Susanoo-no-Mikoto! Crush the evil schemes of the Susano Oh of the Sky, and seal away "Yamata-no-Orochi"! ▼[06]Rangoon, launch!
Susanoo-no-Mikoto! Without your awakening, there can be no victory in the battle against evil! ▼[06]Win the battle against evil!
[06]Head through "Ama-no-Iwato," the cave to the northwest, to the castle of the Susano Oh of the Sky! ▼[06]The greatest evil, Yamata-no-Orochi, is already drawing near to this world! Hurry!
Heh heh heh... How do you like the battlefield Lord Susano Oh of the Sky made for us?
[06]I'll give you credit for getting this far, but I can't let you go any further. ▼[06]First, I'll use this precious Magatama to seal your psychic powers!
[06]You can no longer use your greatest weapon, your psychic powers! ▼[06]Your journey ends right here. We'll put an end to you!
Susa, my other self! You'd best come quickly. Yamata-no-Orochi will be here soon. Heh heh heh...
Come to the cliff's edge up north! I'll bring the Sky Castle right up to it! But are you brave enough to come in?
So you came... First, let's see you handle this one!
Heh heh heh... You've grown quite strong, haven't you... As promised, I'll bring the castle to you!
If you don't come quickly, it will all be too late! You'd better hurry!
So that's all you've got... Run home and watch the world end!
Susa... it's me... Mitsurugi. When the Rangoon... was destroyed... I was thrown from the ship...
[07]Listen... carefully... to what I say... Yamata-no-Orochi is... strong...
[07]The only things that can stand against it... are the Sword of Power and the Kusanagi... Don't forget... use... the Kusanagi Sword... use it...
I'm... done for... With my... last Cure... your... health... Goodbye...
I'm up above! Hurry, hurry! You can hear Yamata-no-Orochi's voice, can't you?!
You'd best come quickly! I am on this floor!
The Kusanagi Sword gave off an intense radiance!
Yamata-no-Orochi is writhing in agony! What terrifying power! ▼[06]But... the Kusanagi Sword lost its light.
It's glowing dimly. The light seems to have grown a little stronger.
The radiance is growing!
It shines brighter and brighter!
The Kusanagi Sword gave off a mighty light! Truly a light with the power to crush evil!
The sword has lost its light.
It gives off a pure, clear light, as if born to crush evil.
The sword slipped from your hand, as if it hated to be touched by anyone but its owner.
The Kusanagi Sword is shining brightly!
[07]Here it comes!! Yamata-no-Orochi!!
[07]Let's give it everything we've got, Susa!
The Kusanagi Sword shines brighter and brighter!
Light returned to the Kusanagi Sword!
Susa! We did it! We beat Yamata-no-Orochi! ▼ [07]We saved the world!
[07]That's right, Susa! Your power saved the world.
[07]A lot happened, but... you did something amazing. ▼|Right, Susa?
[07]It's been such a long road, but this journey has come to an end... and we've fulfilled our mission. ▼ [07]Say, Susa... what will you do now?|
»Begin a new journey%| »Rebuild the world%
[07]That's right, Susa! Even when one journey ends, a new one begins from there! ▼ [07]The journey goes on forever and ever.
[07]That's right, Susa! Just because we beat Yamata-no-Orochi doesn't mean the demon beasts are gone. ▼ [07]There are still lots of people in the world who need help!
[07]Anyway... I can see a town over there! ▼ [07]Let's go, Susa!
Shingo Susa! No, Susanoo-no-Mikoto. Here I shall tell you of another Susano Oh.
